            f = body.faces.item(i)
            print(f'  Face[{i}]: area={f.area:.4f} cm^2, type={f.geometry.objectType}')
    else:
        print('No design product found')
    
    # Check existing CAM

    if cam:
        print('\nExisting CAM product found')
        cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(cam)
        print('Setups:', cam.setups.count)
    else:
        print('\nNo CAM product yet')

            # Get tool parameters
            params = tool.parameters
            desc = tool.description

            try:
                dc = params.itemByName('dc')
                diam = dc.value.value * 10  # cm to mm
                print(f'  [{i}] {desc} | D={diam:.2f}mm')

                print(f'  [{i}] {desc}')

        print('TIW library not found, checking folders...')
        for folder_url in tool_libs.childFolderURLs(root_url):

import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam

def run(_context):
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    
    mgr = adsk.cam.CAMManager.get()
    lib_mgr = mgr.libraryManager
    tool_libs = lib_mgr.toolLibraries
    
    root_url = tool_libs.urlByLocation(adsk.cam.LibraryLocations.LocalLibraryLocation)
    tiw_url = None
    for asset_url in tool_libs.childAssetURLs(root_url):
        if 'TIW' in asset_url.toString():
            tiw_url = asset_url
    
    tiw_lib = tool_libs.toolLibraryAtURL(tiw_url)

            p = params.item(j)
            try:
                val = p.value.value
                expr = p.value.expression
                print(f'  {p.name}: {val:.4f} (expr: {expr})')

    for asset_url in tool_libs.childAssetURLs(root_url):

    print(f'TIW lib has {tiw_lib.count} tools')
    
    # Add the two tools we need to the document library:
    # [14] #3 - 1/2" 3Fl Carb TiCN (roughing) - diameter 12.7mm < 10mm pocket radius? NO!
    # 5mm corner radius means max tool diameter is 10mm (radius = 5mm)
    # So for roughing we should use at most 3/8" (9.525mm) tool
    # For finishing, use 3/8" (9.525mm) or smaller
    # 
    # Best approach: 
    #   Rough with 3/8" (9.525mm) carbide - #7 index 28
    #   Finish with 1/4" (6.35mm) carbide  - #9 index 35 (allows full corner cleaning)
    # Actually 3/8" = 9.525mm, radius = 4.7625mm < 5mm - it fits the 5mm corner radius!
    # But just barely. Let's use 3/8" for both rough and finish.
    # For roughing: #7 at index 28 - 3/8" 3FL Carb ZrN
    # For finishing: #9 at index 35 - 1/4" 3FL TiCN Carb (smaller for better finish)
    
    doc_lib = cam.documentToolLibrary

def run(_context):
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    
    body = design.rootComponent.bRepBodies.item(0)
    doc_lib = cam.documentToolLibrary
    rough_tool = doc_lib.item(4)   # 3/8" carbide
    finish_tool = doc_lib.item(5)  # 1/4" carbide
    
    # Find pocket floor face (z=3.0cm, area=35.79cm2)
    pocket_floor = None
    for i in range(body.faces.count):
        f = body.faces.item(i)
        bb = f.boundingBox
        if ('Plane' in f.geometry.objectType and 
            abs(bb.minPoint.z - 3.0) < 0.001 and 
            abs(bb.maxPoint.z - 3.0) < 0.001 and 
            abs(f.area - 35.7854) < 0.1):
            pocket_floor = f
            break
    print(f'Pocket floor: {pocket_floor is not None}')
    
    # ===== CREATE SETUP =====
    setup_inp = cam.setups.createInput(adsk.cam.OperationTypes.MillingOperation)
    setup_inp.models = [body]
    setup = cam.setups.add(setup_inp)
    setup.name = 'Pocket Milling - 6061 Al'
    
    sp = setup.parameters
    # WCS: origin at top-center of stock, model orientation
    sp.itemByName('wcs_orientation_mode').expression = "'modelOrientation'"
    sp.itemByName('wcs_origin_mode').expression = "'stockPoint'"
    sp.itemByName('wcs_origin_boxPoint').expression = "'top center'"
    # Stock: no offset (matches part exactly)
    sp.itemByName('job_stockMode').expression = "'default'"
    sp.itemByName('job_stockOffsetMode').expression = "'simple'"
    sp.itemByName('job_stockOffsetSides').expression = "'0 mm'"
    sp.itemByName('job_stockOffsetTop').expression = "'0 mm'"
    sp.itemByName('job_stockOffsetBottom').expression = "'0 mm'"
    print(f'Setup created: {setup.name}')
    
    # ===== OP 1: ROUGHING - 2D Adaptive Clearing =====
    rough_inp = setup.operations.createInput('adaptive2d')
    rough_inp.tool = rough_tool
    rough_op = setup.operations.add(rough_inp)
    rough_op.name = 'Rough - 2D Adaptive'
    
    # Geometry: pocket floor defines the pocket boundary
    p = rough_op.parameters.itemByName('pockets')
    cv = adsk.cam.CadContours2dParameterValue.cast(p.value)
    css = cv.getCurveSelections()
    css.clear()
    sel = css.createNewPocketSelection()
    sel.inputGeometry = [pocket_floor]
    cv.applyCurveSelections(css)
    
    # Parameters

    rp.itemByName('tool_feedCutting').expression = '1800 mm/min'
    rp.itemByName('tool_feedRamp').expression = '600 mm/min'
    rp.itemByName('tool_feedPlunge').expression = '400 mm/min'

    rp.itemByName('maximumStepdown').expression = '8 mm'   # ~85% of D, good for Al
    rp.itemByName('stockToLeave').expression = '0.25 mm'   # radial+axial stock for finish
    print(f'Rough op configured: {rough_op.name}')
    
    # ===== OP 2: FLOOR FINISHING - 2D Pocket =====
    floor_inp = setup.operations.createInput('pocket2d')
    floor_inp.tool = finish_tool
    floor_op = setup.operations.add(floor_inp)
    floor_op.name = 'Finish Floor - 2D Pocket'
    
    # Geometry
    p2 = floor_op.parameters.itemByName('pockets')
    cv2 = adsk.cam.CadContours2dParameterValue.cast(p2.value)
    css2 = cv2.getCurveSelections()
    css2.clear()
    sel2 = css2.createNewPocketSelection()
    sel2.inputGeometry = [pocket_floor]
    cv2.applyCurveSelections(css2)
    
    # Parameters
    fp = floor_op.parameters
    fp.itemByName('tool_spindleSpeed').expression = '6000 rpm'
    fp.itemByName('tool_feedCutting').expression = '1200 mm/min'
    fp.itemByName('tool_feedRamp').expression = '400 mm/min'
    fp.itemByName('tool_feedPlunge').expression = '300 mm/min'
    fp.itemByName('maximumStepover').expression = '2.5 mm'  # 40% of 1/4" D
    fp.itemByName('doMultipleDepths').expression = 'false'
    fp.itemByName('stockToLeave').expression = '0 mm'
    fp.itemByName('verticalStockToLeave').expression = '0 mm'
    print(f'Floor finish op configured: {floor_op.name}')
    
    # ===== OP 3: WALL FINISHING - 2D Contour =====
    wall_inp = setup.operations.createInput('contour2d')
    wall_inp.tool = finish_tool
    wall_op = setup.operations.add(wall_inp)
    wall_op.name = 'Finish Walls - 2D Contour'
    
    # Geometry: outside loops of pocket floor = pocket wall loop
    p3 = wall_op.parameters.itemByName('contours')
    cv3 = adsk.cam.CadContours2dParameterValue.cast(p3.value)
    css3 = cv3.getCurveSelections()
    css3.clear()
    sel3 = css3.createNewFaceContourSelection()
    sel3.inputGeometry = [pocket_floor]
    sel3.loopType = adsk.cam.LoopTypes.OnlyOutsideLoops
    sel3.sideType = adsk.cam.SideTypes.AlwaysInsideSideType
    cv3.applyCurveSelections(css3)

    wp.itemByName('tool_feedCutting').expression = '1200 mm/min'
    wp.itemByName('tool_feedRamp').expression = '400 mm/min'

    wp.itemByName('doLeadOut').expression = 'true'

    fp.itemByName('tool_feedPlunge').expression = '300 mm/min'

    fp.itemByName('stockToLeave').expression = '0 mm'
    fp.itemByName('verticalStockToLeave').expression = '0 mm'
    print(f'Op[1]: {floor_op.name}')
    
    # OP 3: WALL FINISHING - 2D Contour
    wall_inp = setup.operations.createInput('contour2d')
    wall_inp.tool = finish_tool
    wall_op = setup.operations.add(wall_inp)
    wall_op.name = 'Finish Walls - 2D Contour'

    doc_lib = cam.documentToolLibrary
    rough_tool = doc_lib.item(4)  # 9.525mm
    finish_tool = doc_lib.item(5) # 6.35mm
    
    setup = cam.setups.item(0)
    
    # Delete existing broken ops
    while setup.operations.count > 0:
        setup.operations.item(0).deleteMe()
    print(f'Cleared ops. Setup now has {setup.operations.count} ops')
    
    # Find pocket floor
    pocket_floor = None
    for i in range(body.faces.count):
        f = body.faces.item(i)
        bb = f.boundingBox
        if ('Plane' in f.geometry.objectType and abs(bb.minPoint.z - 3.0) < 0.001 and 
            abs(f.area - 35.7854) < 0.1):
            pocket_floor = f
            break
    print(f'Pocket floor: {pocket_floor is not None}')
    
    def set_pocket_geom(op, face):
        p = op.parameters.itemByName('pockets')
        cv = adsk.cam.CadContours2dParameterValue.cast(p.value)
        css = cv.getCurveSelections()
        css.clear()
        sel = css.createNewPocketSelection()
        sel.inputGeometry = [face]
        cv.applyCurveSelections(css)
    
    def set_contour_geom(op, face):
        p = op.parameters.itemByName('contours')
        cv = adsk.cam.CadContours2dParameterValue.cast(p.value)
        css = cv.getCurveSelections()
        css.clear()
        sel = css.createNewFaceContourSelection()
        sel.inputGeometry = [face]
        sel.loopType = adsk.cam.LoopTypes.OnlyOutsideLoops
        sel.sideType = adsk.cam.SideTypes.AlwaysInsideSideType
        cv.applyCurveSelections(css)
    
    def set_heights(op_p):
        # Heights: WCS origin at stock top, pocket is 20mm deep
        op_p.itemByName('topHeight_mode').expression = "'from stock top'"
        op_p.itemByName('topHeight_offset').expression = "0mm"
        op_p.itemByName('bottomHeight_mode').expression = "'from stock top'"
        op_p.itemByName('bottomHeight_offset').expression = "-20mm"
        op_p.itemByName('retractHeight_mode').expression = "'from stock top'"
        op_p.itemByName('retractHeight_offset').expression = "5mm"
        op_p.itemByName('clearanceHeight_mode').expression = "'from stock top'"
        op_p.itemByName('clearanceHeight_offset').expression = "10mm"
    
    # OP 1: ROUGHING - 2D Adaptive Clearing
    # Strategy: aggressive HSM trochoidal pocket clearing, 30% radial WOC, 84% DOC
    rough_inp = setup.operations.createInput('adaptive2d')
    rough_inp.tool = rough_tool
    rough_op = setup.operations.add(rough_inp)
    rough_op.name = 'Rough - 2D Adaptive'
    set_pocket_geom(rough_op, pocket_floor)
    set_heights(rough_op.parameters)
    rp = rough_op.parameters
    rp.itemByName('tool_spindleSpeed').expression = '6000 rpm'
    rp.itemByName('tool_feedCutting').expression = '1800 mm/min'
    rp.itemByName('tool_feedRamp').expression = '600 mm/min'
    rp.itemByName('tool_feedPlunge').expression = '400 mm/min'
    rp.itemByName('optimalLoad').expression = '2.85 mm'    # 30% of 9.525mm
    rp.itemByName('stockToLeave').expression = '0.25 mm'   # for finish pass
    print(f'Op[0] ready: {rough_op.name}')
    
    # OP 2: FLOOR FINISHING - 2D Pocket
    # Single-depth floor finish, 40% stepover, no stock
    floor_inp = setup.operations.createInput('pocket2d')
    floor_inp.tool = finish_tool
    floor_op = setup.operations.add(floor_inp)
    floor_op.name = 'Finish Floor - 2D Pocket'
    set_pocket_geom(floor_op, pocket_floor)
    set_heights(floor_op.parameters)
    fp = floor_op.parameters
    fp.itemByName('tool_spindleSpeed').expression = '6000 rpm'
    fp.itemByName('tool_feedCutting').expression = '1200 mm/min'
    fp.itemByName('tool_feedRamp').expression = '400 mm/min'
    fp.itemByName('tool_feedPlunge').expression = '300 mm/min'
    fp.itemByName('maximumStepover').expression = '2.5mm'
    fp.itemByName('doMultipleDepths').expression = 'false'
    fp.itemByName('stockToLeave').expression = '0mm'
    fp.itemByName('verticalStockToLeave').expression = '0mm'
    print(f'Op[1] ready: {floor_op.name}')
    
    # OP 3: WALL FINISHING - 2D Contour
    # Single-depth contour pass along pocket walls
    wall_inp = setup.operations.createInput('contour2d')
    wall_inp.tool = finish_tool
    wall_op = setup.operations.add(wall_inp)
    wall_op.name = 'Finish Walls - 2D Contour'
    set_contour_geom(wall_op, pocket_floor)
    set_heights(wall_op.parameters)
    wp = wall_op.parameters
    wp.itemByName('tool_spindleSpeed').expression = '6000 rpm'
    wp.itemByName('tool_feedCutting').expression = '1200 mm/min'
    wp.itemByName('tool_feedRamp').expression = '400 mm/min'
    wp.itemByName('tool_feedPlunge').expression = '300 mm/min'
    wp.itemByName('doMultipleDepths').expression = 'false'
    wp.itemByName('stockToLeave').expression = '0mm'
    wp.itemByName('verticalStockToLeave').expression = '0mm'
    wp.itemByName('useStockToLeave').expression = 'false'
    print(f'Op[2] ready: {wall_op.name}')
    
    print(f'\nTotal ops: {setup.operations.count}')
    
    # Check editable errors
    print('\nEditable errors check:')
    any_err = False
    for i in range(setup.operations.count):
        op_i = setup.operations.item(i)
        for j in range(op_i.parameters.count):
            p2 = op_i.parameters.item(j)
            if p2.error and p2.isEditable:
                print(f'  Op[{i}] [{p2.name}]: {p2.error}')
                any_err = True
    if not any_err:
        print('  None!')
    
    # GENERATE ALL
    print('\nGenerating all toolpaths...')
    future = cam.generateAllToolpaths(False)
    adsk.doEvents()
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 300
    tick = 0
    while not future.isGenerationCompleted:
        if time.monotonic() > deadline:
            print('TIMEOUT'); break
        adsk.doEvents(); time.sleep(0.5)
        tick += 1
        if tick % 20 == 0:
            print(f'  ...{tick*0.5:.0f}s...')
    
    print(f'\nGeneration done: {future.isGenerationCompleted}')
    all_valid = True
    for i in range(setup.operations.count):
        op_i = setup.operations.item(i)
        h = op_i.hasToolpath
        v = op_i.isToolpathValid
        print(f'Op[{i}] {op_i.name}: hasTP={h} valid={v}')
        if not v:
            all_valid = False
            for j in range(op_i.parameters.count):
                p2 = op_i.parameters.item(j)
                if p2.error and p2.isEditable:
                    print(f'  ERR [{p2.name}]: {p2.error}')
    print(f'\n>>> ALL VALID: {all_valid} <<<')
